title: Typed dict indexing is inconsistent at best and wrong at worst
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.8.dev4.official [b56a91878],v4.8.dev3.official [51105ccbe], 4.7.2.stable, 4.4.1.stable, v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

no typed dicts before 4.4.stable 

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 02 Jun 2026 18:26:58 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 610.43.02) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads) - 31.19 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

consider the following situation
```gdscript
class Thing: pass
class SpecificThing extends Thing: pass

var thing_collection:Dictionary[Thing, bool]

```
IMO it should be valid for thing_collection to hold SpecificThings
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	var specific:SpecificThing = SpecificThing.new()
	thing_collection[specific] = true #doesn't work
	thing_collection[specific as Thing] = true #does work
```
but it seems to require explicitly casting to the ancestor class.
worse, I have every code warning enabled and it is not flagged*
until it tries to run

*except when it is. if you open the file with this syntax, it will be detected, but not after modifying it and then modifying it back (achieved in the video with duplicating the file)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/03334528-f4c6-4279-a494-ef7491a792ee


### Steps to reproduce

open mrp or create a new project and paste code into a new script
if the code was opened it will show an error, this state can be left by commenting the line and saving, now uncommenting and optionally saving will not show the error anymore.

trying to run the project with this script referenced in it will show the Parser Error.



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31571589/MRP.zip)
